title: Grogu
description: As a youngling, Grogu escaped the carnage of the Jedi Purge with the help of Kelleran Beq. By the time of the New Republic, Grogu was hunted by bounty hunters paid by the Imperial Remnant. Captured by Din Djarin, the two formed a close bond and the Mandalorian bounty hunter saved him from experimentation by the Imperials. The pair went on the run, eventually parting ways when Luke Skywalker found Grogu and trained him in the ways of the Jedi. Grogu, however, ultimately chose the path of the Mandalorian.
